artist_notes.name: Aundreja
artist_notes.note: LA-born hard techno/trance DJ on a fast local rise since 2023; has played Exchange LA and European dates.

artist_notes.name: John Bryars
artist_notes.note: LA local eclectic acid/techno/electro/EBM selector; has played A Club Called Rhonda.

artist_notes.name: Katie Rex
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn techno/industrial DJ and BOUND NYC founder; dark, hardgroove-leaning.

curator_note: Secret-location DTLA all-nighter that runs to 6am, with a bill of local up-and-comers and a Brooklyn guest. It leans harder and darker than your groove side, but the warehouse-until-sunrise format is the draw. Check the address drop before buying.
description: Late-night techno party in a to-be-announced DTLA location, 11pm to 6am.

artist_notes.name: Jack Faulkner
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/promoter pushing soulful, deep, high-energy house on the West Coast; runs the AXIS open-air series.

curator_note: Soulful deep house under the open sky from the local AXIS crew, running until 5am. It's a low-key, locals-first night, so go for the groove and not for any names.
description: AXIS open-air house party at a TBA location with Jack Faulkner and DJ Gevo.

curator_note: A free house-and-disco night in a Koreatown bar room. The lineup isn't posted, so it's a gamble, but it costs nothing and the disco angle is right. Good for a casual pre-Christmas dance.
description: Free house and disco night from Stereo Punks at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang in Koreatown.

artist_notes.name: Matt Egbert
artist_notes.note: LA deep-house producer and Front Left founder; multiple Beatport #1 deep-house releases, groove-forward.

artist_notes.name: ARISA
artist_notes.note: Couldn't verify a bio; treat as an unknown local.

curator_note: A Thanksgiving-night underground with deep, tech and minimal at a secret address. For about $12, Egbert is a solid LA deep-house name to build it around. It's a decent alternative to sitting through a second dinner.
description: Recollect Underground's Thanksgiving night of deep house, deep tech and minimal at an Instagram-announced location.

curator_note: A Los Globos house/tech-house night with no lineup posted and EDM in the genre tags. It's close to home, so it's an easy walk-in if friends are going. Otherwise skip until names appear.
description: EMX house and tech-house night at Los Globos in Silver Lake; lineup TBA.

artist_notes.name: Patrick Topping
artist_notes.note: Newcastle tech-house DJ, runs the Trick label; known for high-energy, bouncy sets.

curator_note: Topping is reliably one of the most fun tech-house DJs around, and Sound is a good-sized room for him. Tickets are about $42 and the date is far out, so it's an easy one to book early.
description: UK tech-house DJ Patrick Topping headlines a late night at Sound Nightclub in Hollywood.

artist_notes.name: Interplanetary Criminal
artist_notes.note: Manchester producer riding the UK bassline/2-step revival; skippy, rave-adjacent garage.

curator_note: A jungle/garage night off the usual path, headlined by the Manchester UK-garage name you flagged. It's not house, but the UK club feel is right. Worth it if you want a change of pace.
description: Hard Selects presents UK garage, jungle and DnB with Interplanetary Criminal and Osmosis Jones at an industrial space on Mission Rd.

artist_notes.name: Dixon
artist_notes.note: Innervisions co-founder and Berlin melodic house/techno mainstay.

artist_notes.name: Maceo Plex
artist_notes.note: Ellum Audio boss; tech-house/techno crossover, dark and groove-driven.

artist_notes.name: Mano Le Tough
artist_notes.note: Irish, Berlin-based; melodic house on Permanent Vacation.

curator_note: Dixon, Maceo Plex and Mano Le Tough on one bill is the strongest European-flavored club night in this batch, at a big space with a 9pm start. Dixon is tracked and the other two fit the melodic and deep side. Tickets will probably go quickly.
description: Three-headliner night of melodic house and techno from Dixon, Maceo Plex and Mano Le Tough at East End Studios.
